role: Own the hook bank — generate, refine, retire, and promote hooks based on performance data

inputs.data/ig-analytics.json: IG posts — hook_text, reach, likes, engagement
inputs.data/youtube-trends.json: YouTube trend signals for hook ideas
inputs.data/reddit-trends.json: Reddit pain points for hook angles
inputs.data/ab-test-input.json: A/B test results for hook performance

outputs.data/hook-bank.json: Updated hook bank with hooks, variants, recommendations
outputs.data/hook-variants.json: Hook variant candidates for A/B testing

validates: data/hook-bank.json total_hooks matches actual bucket counts
priority_action: Populate hook bank from IG analytics — every post has a hook_text field
